releaseNotes:
• Ads are gone from anime. The player was sending a request the video host rejected, so it silently fell back to an ad-carrying page — it now plays the stream directly.
• Anime works again: search had been returning nothing, and playback pointed at a host that went dark. Both fixed, with better results (searching "naruto" gives you Naruto, not a movie).
• A real offline library — manga, novels and anime episodes, kept for good.
• Ask Sakura about the chapter you're reading without leaving it; it knows where you are and won't spoil ahead.
• Reader: page seek bar with chapter jumps, and back returns to the series instead of a blank screen.
• Novels: the reader now finds the novels that were there all along.
• The app no longer shifts and resizes on its own while you're using it.
• Security: fake "you received SAKURA" notifications and unauthorised profile edits are both closed.
